items.title: Utilities lobby for shield from wildfire costs
items.summary: As a criminal investigation into Southern California Edison actions before last year's deadly Eaton fire continues, the state's for-profit utilities are lobbying for legislation that would protect their shareholders from paying for future catastrophic fires they cause.

items.title: PG&E (PCG) Becomes First Energy Utility With EMAP Emergency Accreditation
items.summary: PG&E (NYSE:PCG) became the first energy utility worldwide to secure emergency management accreditation from EMAP. The Emergency Management Accreditation Program recognition covers PG&E's readiness, response, and recovery processes for major crises. EMAP accreditation is an internationally recognized benchmark often used by public agencies to assess emergency management capabilities.
